svg.desc: Merge order from the 3 November 2026 review. Rows are steps 2 to 22; columns are earlier steps 1 to 21. Purple intensity represents 1, 2 to 3, 4 to 9, or 10 or more conflicting files. Outlined cells mean no conflict. The selected pair is step 21, feat/comment-hunk, with step 20, dev-3-way-diff-second-attempt: 17 files. The README provides feature descriptions, merge order, and conflict counts as text.
